draft.subject: Your SSO question + next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for your note on SSO setup -- your ticket is still open on our side and I'm staying on it. To answer the core question: SSO is available on the Team plan, so on Starter it isn't something you can switch on today. Glad the Slack issue is sorted too.

In the meantime, the fastest way to get value out of Wrenfield is getting a colleague in alongside you -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Want me to walk you through that first invite this week?

Best,
Chidi
